student.legalFlow.intro.APOSTILLE: {{country}} is part of the Apostille Convention, so one apostille replaces embassy legalization. Only these steps apply to you.
student.legalFlow.intro.CONSULAR_LEGALIZATION: {{country}} is not part of the Apostille Convention, so the document is legalized in two stages: first by your government, then by the Korean embassy.
student.legalFlow.intro.ISSUER_VERIFICATION: The issuer verifies this document directly. Only these steps apply to you.
student.legalFlow.note.JOINED: {{country}} joined the Apostille Convention on {{date}}. Documents legalized by the consulate before that date are generally still accepted — confirm with your university.
student.legalFlow.note.JOINS: {{country}} joins the Apostille Convention on {{date}}; until then documents need Korean consular confirmation.
student.legalFlow.note.UNVERIFIED: We have not verified the legalization route for this country yet — your counselor will confirm.
student.legalFlow.onlyIfRequired: only if the issuer requires it
student.legalFlow.step.apostille.title: Get an apostille from the competent authority in {{country}}
student.legalFlow.step.apostille.where: The apostille authority in {{country}} (usually the foreign or justice ministry)
student.legalFlow.step.apostille.why: It proves to Korea that the document is genuine — no embassy visit needed.
student.legalFlow.step.chsi.title: Get the CHSI / CDGDC verification report
student.legalFlow.step.chsi.why: Many Korean universities ask Chinese applicants for this official degree verification report.
student.legalFlow.step.consular.title: Get consular confirmation at the Korean embassy or consulate in {{country}}
student.legalFlow.step.consular.where: The Korean embassy or consulate in {{country}}
student.legalFlow.step.consular.why: The Korean embassy then confirms your ministry's stamp, so Korean universities accept it.
student.legalFlow.step.mofa.title: Authenticate it at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of {{country}}
student.legalFlow.step.mofa.where: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs in {{country}}
student.legalFlow.step.mofa.why: Your government confirms the issuer's signature and seal first.
student.legalFlow.step.notarize.title: Notarize the copy if the issuing authority requires it
student.legalFlow.step.notarize.why: Some authorities apostille or legalize only notarized copies.
student.legalFlow.step.original.title: Get the official original (or a certified copy) from the issuer
student.legalFlow.step.original.where: The school or authority that issued it
student.legalFlow.step.original.why: Korean universities only accept originals or certified copies.
student.legalFlow.step.translation.title: Certified translation into Korean or English if the document is in another language
student.legalFlow.step.translation.where: A certified translator (or a translation notarized in {{country}})
student.legalFlow.step.translation.why: Universities read Korean or English; other languages need a certified translation.
student.legalFlow.step.verify.title: Upload it for Hangyul verification
student.legalFlow.step.verify.why: Your counselor checks it once, and it is reused for every application.

visaroute.caveat.FEE_EXEMPTION_UNCHECKED: Whether Thai nationals pay the visa fee still needs a check — your counselor confirms.
visaroute.caveat.FEE_TIME_CONFLICT: Official pages disagree on the fee and processing time — your counselor confirms them.
visaroute.caveat.FUNDS_PERIOD_CONFLICT: The embassy and the national manual differ on how many months of money language students must show — your counselor confirms.
visaroute.caveat.LEGALIZATION_UNCLEAR: The embassy's list and the national visa manual differ on how your school documents must be confirmed (translated copy vs. consular confirmation) — your counselor confirms which one you need.
visaroute.caveat.POST_SPLIT_UNVERIFIED: We couldn't confirm which regions the Manila and Cebu posts each cover — your counselor tells you where to apply.
visaroute.caveat.POST_UNRESOLVED: We couldn't confirm which post covers your area — your counselor tells you where to apply.
visaroute.caveat.ROUTE_PARTIAL: Some details for this route are not confirmed yet. Your counselor checks them with the embassy before you apply.
